title: "Stat2 Python Notes"

abstract: "A browsable collection of Python marimo notes migrated from the Stat2 Julia exercises."
---

The `python` branch holds the migration of the original Stat2 examples. Each note keeps the original directory and filename, reads course data from `Stat2Data`, and is intended to run locally in the `lock5stat-env` conda environment.

::: {.callout-note}
The links below open the Python source for each marimo note. GitHub Pages renders the Quarto documentation site; marimo executes the notes in a local Python environment.
:::

## Running a note locally

```bash
conda activate lock5stat-env
marimo edit UnitB-Anova/ch05/p540-rat-fat.py
```

The source notes use Polars for tabular data, Great Tables for exploratory summaries, and SciPy or statsmodels for statistical models where the Julia source has been translated.
